pathways.compact_statement: Forced settlement of Tonle Sap floating communities restricted seasonal mobility and fishing access, increasing vulnerability to water variability.
alternative_explanations: Dams, land development, agricultural change and fishing restrictions also alter hydrology and access; climate contributions are not isolated.
pathways.uncertainty: Historical three-community ethnography, not a representative causal estimate. Reverse interaction concerns coercive relocation and exclusion, not armed-conflict classification.
recommendations: Keep the reverse mechanism bounded to the named institution, population and place supported by its cited evidence; do not infer violence from climate vulnerability.
